verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, so operating a web browser on the user's behalf is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents browser automation. The nearby items do not qualify: app integrations, MCP tool extensions, human taskers for reservations or orders, and a 'Send to Poke' right-click for selected webpage text are adjacent features, not the assistant itself browsing and completing tasks on websites.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
